subject: Request: DPA + Sub-processor Disclosure for CatalystPay pilot
messages:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver@catalystpay.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@catalystpay.com
Date: Sun, 09 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: DPA + subprocessors for upcoming pilot

Hi Chloe,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We are moving toward a short pilot and need to get privacy terms squared away before we turn on test data. Two quick asks to start the formal intake: 

1) Can you share Redwood's standard DPA (template) so our legal team can review?
2) We need an up-to-date list of subprocessors and where they process data (US/EU). Our compliance review is particularly focused on EU transfers — are SCCs used, or do you have an EU-hosted option?
3) Preferred e-sign route (DocuSign vs Adobe Sign) — procurement prefers DocuSign but wants to confirm Redwood's ability to execute.

Attached is a short dataflow diagram and our intake questionnaire for your convenience. Looking for a quick turnaround (ideally 48 hours) so procurement can slot this for next week's review.

Cheers,
Oliver
Head of Partnerships | CatalystPay

Attachments: catalystpay_dataflow_v1.png (image), CatalystPay_DPA_Questionnaire.pdf (pdf)
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@catalystpay.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 09 Aug 2026 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: DPA + subprocessors for upcoming pilot

Hi Oliver — thanks for the clear note. Looping in Marcus (solutions) who will validate the intended data flows.

Quick answers up front:
- We can provide our standard DPA template for review (attached).
- Subprocessor list is attached as a snapshot (we update monthly). It shows region and role; we use SCCs for EU transfers by default and offer EU-hosted deployments for dedicated/private customers. For hosted trials we typically rely on SCCs + documented technical controls.
- DocuSign is our preferred e-sign path and the legal team prepares a DocuSign envelope for signature. AdobeSign is possible but will add an extra step.

A couple of clarifying questions so we attach the right annexes:
1) For the pilot, will CatalystPay send any personal data of EU residents?
2) Do you require specific retention language or deletion windows beyond our standard 90-day transient KV retention for logs?

Attached: Redwood_DPA_Template_v2.docx, subprocessor_snapshot_2026-08.csv

If you want, Laura (legal) can run a quick redline pass once we know the retention requirements.

Best,
Chloe
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_Template_v2.docx (docx), subprocessor_snapshot_2026-08.csv (csv)
From: Oliver Grant <oliver@catalystpay.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@catalystpay.com
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA + subprocessors for upcoming pilot

Chloe — thanks. Answering your questions below and attaching our intake notes.

1) Yes — pilot will include anonymized EU customer emails and a small set of personally identifying billing contacts (name, email) — we would like confirmation SCCs are in place and that Redwood can provide the subprocessors CSV for audit.
2) Retention: For the pilot, procurement asks for 180-day retention for logs and an explicit deletion certificate after project close. Is that acceptable?

Procurement note: procurement@catalystpay.com prefers DocuSign and would like a sample envelope link so our legal can confirm the signing experience.

Attached: CatalystPay_Intake_Notes.pdf

—Oliver
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@catalystpay.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 11:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: DPA + subprocessors for upcoming pilot

Hi Oliver / Chloe — Laura from Legal here. Thanks for the details. Quick thoughts: 

• SCCs are fine as a transfer mechanism for hosted trials; we will confirm the controller-processor mapping in the DPA annex.
• 180-day retention is longer than our standard; I can propose DPA language that permits a 180-day logs retention for this pilot with an auto-expiry clause and a deletion certificate commitment on project termination.
• We keep a running subprocessor register (the CSV Chloe attached); for audit requests we can provide a signed attestation and timestamps for the CSV snapshot.

If the CatalystPay team can confirm the expected start date for the pilot and whether you require an audit window, I will prepare a redline and a DocuSign envelope ready for signature.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@catalystpay.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, procurement@catalystpay.com
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: DPA + subprocessors for upcoming pilot

Oliver / Procurement —

Thanks — summary & next steps: 
1) Redwood will accept a 180-day logs retention for the pilot (DPA annex to reflect this).
2) We will provide a signed subprocessor attestation (CSV snapshot) and confirm SCCs are applied for EU transfers.
3) Legal will produce a single redline of the attached Redwood DPA and deliver via DocuSign. Expect a DocuSign envelope link by EOD tomorrow.

DocuSign envelope (sample / placeholder): https://www.docusign.com/en/documents/envelope/ABC123def
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/4782

If all good, procurement can expect the envelope and signature flow, then we can schedule the pilot kickoff for the week of Aug 23.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this across the finish line.

Best,
Chloe
